dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the residents and local government of the city of Price, Utah, and federal land management operations.
dimensions.evidence: convey certain Bureau of Land Management land to the city of Price, Utah

dimensions.assessment: Local land transfer enabling the construction of a water reservoir and related public infrastructure.
dimensions.evidence: the construction of a reservoir and related infrastructure

dimensions.assessment: Involves land conveyance without stating federal purchase or sale prices or specific appropriations.
Applies a specific legislative land conveyance and reversion mechanism to a defined 124.23-acre parcel.
dimensions.evidence: approximately 124.23 acres of Bureau of Land Management land in the State of Utah

dimensions.assessment: Permanent transfer of land title to the city, subject to permanent conditions regarding authorized public uses and potential federal reversion.
dimensions.evidence: all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Federal land, to be used by the City for public purposes

missing_information: Financial valuation of the 124.23 acres of federal land being conveyed.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of the Interior to convey approximately 124.23 acres of Bureau of Land Management land to the city of Price, Utah, for public purposes including reservoir and infrastructure development, subject to potential reversion.
